Elective day surgery.requires: a fit patient and a routine list
Elective day surgery.provides: predictable duration, discharge the same day

Major planned resection.requires: a long booked slot and critical care backup
Major planned resection.provides: many hours of theatre time, a post-operative bed required

Emergency laparotomy.provides: displacement of planned work, no possibility of deferral

Trauma call in resuscitation.provides: immediate theatre access, everything else stopped

No critical care bed available.requires: an intensive care unit at capacity
No critical care bed available.provides: cancellation of any case needing one, no effect on day cases

Surgeon unavailable.provides: only cases the remaining team can do, a list part-used

Equipment set unsterilised.provides: no procedure needing that set, other work unaffected

Full staffing and capacity.requires: theatres, beds and teams all available
Full staffing and capacity.provides: the planned list deliverable, normal running

Strict clinical urgency.provides: the sickest treated first, planned work displaced

Longest waiting first.provides: fairness on time waited, no regard to acuity

Efficiency of list packing.provides: maximum cases per session, short cases favoured

Cancel and reschedule.provides: the list relieved, harm to waiting time targets

Full list completed.provides: every booked patient treated, no cancellations

Late cases cancelled.provides: patients sent home unoperated, theatre time lost

List abandoned for emergencies.provides: no elective work done, all capacity to urgent cases
